name: Surface Source Space
summary: Computes a cortical surface source space from a FreeSurfer reconstruction with MNE-Python setup_source_space and outputs src.fif with a QC report.
description: Places candidate dipole sources on the FreeSurfer white surface at the chosen spacing (e.g. oct6, 4098 sources per hemisphere) with mne.setup_source_space, optionally adding distance and patch information, and renders the source points on the MRI. Use it to prepare the source space for an MEG/EEG forward model. It needs a FreeSurfer recon-all subject directory and a FreeSurfer license.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer subject directory produced by recon-all.

outputs.description: Surface source space (src.fif) for use by forward-model Apps.

parameters.description:
Source density. Examples: 
oct6 = 4098 sources/hemisphere (recommended)
 oct5 = 1026 (faster)
oct4 = 258 (testing only)
ico5 = 10242 (high density)
or a number like '10' for ~10mm grid spacing.
Add distance and patch information to the source space. This takes some time so precomputing it is recommended. Can also be ‘patch’ to only compute patch information.

options.label: No
options.description: Fastest. No distance or patch info computed.

options.label: Patch only
options.description: Computes patch information (requires SciPy). Recommended if unsure.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, Heinsfeld AS, et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21:809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7:267 (2013).
